(no comments)
{"decision": "push", "reason": "页面描述了一个具体的小工具：输入美国任意地址即可生成包含地块线、等高线、土壤、洪水区、湿地和建筑体量的场地底图，可直接导入 AutoCAD、SketchUp、Civil 3D 和 GIS，并给出奥林匹亚滨水地块的示例 PDF。这是对建筑/土木设计师一个具体而容易被忽视的需求的垂直切入，且页面内容具体、专业，值得一看。"}

verdict.reasoning: The reason's claims are all on the page: any US address, parcel lines, contours, soils, flood zones, wetlands, building massing, export to AutoCAD/SketchUp/Civil 3D/GIS, and an example PDF for an Olympia waterfront lot. The "easily overlooked need" remark is opinion, not a factual claim. It names concrete features and a target user (architects and civil designers), and it supports push.
